sandeep: quick sanity check — brought up mistral-7b q8x4 on A100/H100 across us/eu/apac, seeing a huge decode p95 spike in apac on A100, attaching bench dump
bench-bot: run 2736543210 - model=mistral-7b q=8x4 prefill+decode 1s samples
bench-bot: ```
region,device,prefill_p50_ms,decode_p50_ms,decode_p95_ms,tokens_per_sec,$_per_1M
us,h100,42,18,28,12000,1.45
us,a100,44,22,35,9200,1.88
eu,h100,48,20,30,11500,1.52
eu,a100,50,25,40,8800,1.95
apac,h100,60,26,36,9800,1.70

```
molly: whoa — apac A100 decode_p95=210ms and tokens/sec halved, that's massive
aj: likely kernel fallthrough to generic attention kernel on those nodes; could be seq-length or runtime flag mismatch
taylor: any driver/kernel diffs in apac? we did the kernel rollout last week (v510) but configs should match
sandeep: drivers are same across regions (510.47). however we toggled a runtime flag in apac A100 for an A/B test: --enable-fast-attn=false
nora: that flag forces fallback paths — would explain slow p95. re-enable fast-attn on A100 to match H100 path
molly: can someone paste the routing config? curious if fanout/cross-zone is contributing
aj: routing snippet:
```
{"policy":"latency_then_cost","fallbacks":["h100","a100_int8","a100_fp16"],"region_preference":["local","cross_zone"]}
```
aj: when local A100 pool saturates we fan out to cross-zone A100 replicas that have mixed runtime flags -> cold KV cache + slower kernels
sandeep: tl;dr: combination of --enable-fast-attn=false on some apac nodes + fanout to cold replicas => huge p95 and lower tokens/sec in apac A100
taylor: proposed action: 1) pin apac traffic to H100 until we resolve, 2) add kernel-consistency gate in rollout, 3) expose per-region $/1M tokens in console and alert on 2x cost delta
molly: also add a canary guard: if decode_p95 > 3x baseline, block full rollout :thumbsup:
nora: I'll roll a canary that re-enables fast-attn on 2 A100 nodes now
sandeep: thanks. note on ops cost: in this bench H100 $_per_1M ~1.70 vs apac A100 4.10 for this workload — big cost swing if left unaddressed
molly: capacity rough calc: if we stick with H100 (tokens/sec ~9800) and target 1k concurrent users avg 40 tokens => 40k tps -> 40k/9800 ~= 4.1 -> 5 H100 GPUs for apac. adjusting from A100 sizing which would have needed ~10 GPUs given 4200 tps
aj: bench-bot starting canary run now
